name: EPIC 206439424
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 12.4 solar radii and 1.58 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206439424 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.437183 (16th-84th percentiles 11.93842-13.037708), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206439424: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4808.311 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206439424 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3140 (16th-84th percentiles 3032.96875-3290.234375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.10 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,140 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.58 solar masses and 12.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,808 K at its surface.
